title: Production Capability Registry and Selection Engine
note: P3 approved by User on 2026-10-03. Approval is bounded to the P3 capability engine and project selection, INCLUDING the documented INCIDENT-P3-001 closure. It confers NO approval of P4.

requirements.title: Deterministic production promotion gate
requirements.objective: A capability may enter the production registry only through a gate that rejects every insufficient-evidence state
requirements.description: Research findings must not become production by default.
acceptance_criteria: promote() returns ok only when every required field is present and valid
Cases A-O of the negative suite are each rejected by a named gate rule
A positive control proves a valid capability IS promoted

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Deterministic evidence-weighted ranking
requirements.objective: Ranking must be reproducible and must not be decided by popularity
requirements.description: Popularity and recency are tie-breakers only.
acceptance_criteria: Twenty-four input permutations produce one identical ranking fingerprint
A candidate with ten million stars cannot outrank a higher evidence score
Every ranked candidate carries an explanation and a factor breakdown

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Forced user choice honoured, safety constraints absolute
requirements.objective: An explicit user choice must win over automatic ranking, subject to non-overridable safety
requirements.description: The system must not silently replace the user's choice, nor obey it into unsafe territory.
acceptance_criteria: A forced choice moves the selected capability to rank 1 and records its former rank
A forced choice on a VULNERABLE or SUSPECTED_RISK capability is refused with a stated reason

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Research remains research
requirements.objective: P2 research must not be promoted to production without independent evidence
requirements.description: Research is a candidate, not a capability.
acceptance_criteria: Every deferred candidate carries a stated reason
No P2 research record id appears in the production registry
CONF-001 and CAP-028 remain unresolved and unverified

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Project-local only, nothing installed
requirements.objective: P3 must not install software or write machine-global state
requirements.description: The mechanism is established before dependency adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Every registered capability has install_scope PROJECT_LOCAL
No node_modules, lockfile or wheel exists under sps2
The selection record states that no machine state was touched

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Stale cannot silently behave as active
requirements.objective: A stale capability must not remain ACTIVE, and staleness must define its consequence
requirements.description: Freshness is a lifecycle property, not a note.
acceptance_criteria: STALE_AS_ACTIVE is rejected
STALE_WITHOUT_REVIEW is rejected
The selection record defines the effect of going stale

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

requirements.title: Provenance is traceable without overclaiming
requirements.objective: Every production capability answers where it came from, on what evidence, and by whom approved
requirements.description: Static provenance must not be presented as runtime tracing.
acceptance_criteria: Every capability carries provenance.origin, commit and fact_class
The selection record sets runtime_tracing to false explicitly
Approval carries decided_by and decided_at
